tasks.title: Design LangGraph Core Architecture
tasks.description: Design and implement the core LangGraph architecture that will serve as the unified backend orchestration engine for the SpaceLive platform.
tasks.details:
Create the foundational LangGraph architecture with the following key components:

1. Core node types:
   - `TimeTriggerNode`: For schedule-based triggers
   - `StateMonitorNode`: For monitoring character state and idle time
   - `UserInputNode`: For processing user inputs
   - `SchedulerNode`: For managing scheduled tasks
   - `LLMInterfaceNode`: For LLM API calls
   - `MemorySystemInterfaceNode`: For memory read/write operations
   - `EmotionAnalyzerNode`: For analyzing text emotions

2. Flow differentiation:
   - Implement simplified path for real-time dialogue
   - Implement complex path for scheduled tasks with tool invocation
   - Implement spontaneous dialogue flow (former Murmur functionality)

3. State management:
   - Design shared state structure for all behavior types
   - Implement state persistence mechanism

Use Python with FastAPI as the backend framework. Ensure the architecture is modular and extensible to accommodate future tools and functionalities.
tasks.testStrategy:
1. Unit tests for each node type to verify correct functionality
2. Integration tests for different flow paths
3. State persistence and recovery tests
4. Performance benchmarking to ensure response times meet requirements (<1.5s for real-time dialogue, <3s for scheduled tasks)
5. Mock external dependencies (LLM, databases) for testing

tasks.title: Implement Three-Layer Memory System
tasks.description: Develop the three-layer memory architecture for the virtual character, including short-term, medium-term, and long-term memory components.
tasks.details:
Design and implement a comprehensive memory system with three distinct layers:

1. Short-term memory:
   - Daily emotion fluctuations
   - Event summaries
   - Task photos
   - Implementation using MongoDB collections with TTL indexes

2. Medium-term memory:
   - Weekly selection of high emotional value events
   - Formation of main storyline events
   - Triggers for appearance changes
   - Implementation using aggregation pipelines to select important events

3. Long-term memory:
   - 52-week memory node chronological wall
   - Audience quote wall
   - Annual autobiographical life trajectory
   - Implementation using specialized collections with indexing for efficient retrieval

Integrate memory system with LangGraph through the `MemorySystemInterfaceNode`. Implement memory retrieval algorithms that prioritize relevant memories based on context, recency, and emotional significance. Ensure proper data structures for storing different memory types and efficient query patterns.
tasks.testStrategy:
1. Unit tests for each memory layer's CRUD operations
2. Integration tests with LangGraph nodes
3. Performance tests for memory retrieval under load
4. Consistency tests to ensure memories are properly categorized
5. Simulated time progression tests to verify medium and long-term memory formation
6. Data integrity tests to prevent memory corruption or loss

tasks.title: Develop Unified Trigger Mechanism in LangGraph
tasks.description: Implement the unified trigger system within LangGraph to handle time-based scheduling, state monitoring, and user input processing.
tasks.details:
Create a comprehensive trigger system within LangGraph that unifies all behavior initiation:

1. Time Trigger Implementation:
   - Develop `TimeTriggerNode` that monitors system time
   - Implement scheduling logic based on the six broadcast periods defined in the PRD
   - Create time-based event detection for special dates or anniversaries
   - Use APScheduler or similar library for reliable time-based execution

2. State Monitor Implementation:
   - Develop `StateMonitorNode` that tracks character state
   - Implement idle time detection to trigger spontaneous dialogue (former Murmur functionality)
   - Monitor emotional state thresholds to trigger appropriate responses
   - Track interaction patterns to adjust behavior

3. User Input Handler:
   - Develop `UserInputNode` for processing real-time user messages
   - Implement priority handling to ensure user interactions take precedence
   - Create input classification to route to appropriate processing paths

4. Trigger Coordination:
   - Implement priority system for handling competing triggers
   - Develop state machine to manage transitions between different triggered states
   - Create logging system for trigger events for debugging and analysis

Ensure all triggers are properly integrated with the WebSocket communication layer for real-time updates to the frontend.
tasks.testStrategy:
1. Unit tests for each trigger type with mock time and state data
2. Integration tests for trigger coordination and priority handling
3. Stress tests with multiple simultaneous triggers
4. Time-based tests with accelerated clock to verify scheduling
5. State transition tests to ensure proper flow between triggered states
6. End-to-end tests with simulated user input and time progression

tasks.title: Implement Scheduler Node and Broadcast Period Logic
tasks.description: Develop the SchedulerNode component in LangGraph to manage the six daily broadcast periods with their specific content and tool combinations.
tasks.details:
Implement the `SchedulerNode` in LangGraph to handle the six broadcast periods defined in the PRD:

1. Period Configuration System:
   - Create a configuration schema for defining broadcast periods
   - Implement parser for the six periods from the PRD (Space Morning Report, Physical Performance, Fantasy Projection, etc.)
   - Design flexible configuration system that can be updated without code changes

2. Period-Specific Tool Orchestration:
   - Implement tool selection logic based on current period
   - Create tool chains for each period's requirements
   - Develop fallback mechanisms for when tools are unavailable

3. Content Generation Coordination:
   - Implement period-appropriate content generation prompts
   - Create context management to maintain thematic consistency within periods
   - Develop transition handling between periods

4. Schedule Execution Engine:
   - Implement precise timing control for period transitions
   - Create progress tracking within periods
   - Develop interruption and resumption capabilities
   - Implement manual override interface for administrators

Ensure the scheduler can handle the specific requirements of each period, such as news fetching for Space Morning Report, animation control for Physical Performance period, and AI image generation for Fantasy Projection period.
tasks.testStrategy:
1. Unit tests for period configuration parsing and validation
2. Integration tests for tool orchestration in each period
3. Timing tests to verify period transitions
4. Content appropriateness tests for each period
5. Manual override tests
6. Fault tolerance tests with simulated tool failures
7. End-to-end tests for full daily schedule execution

tasks.title: Develop Emotion Analysis and Expression System
tasks.description: Implement the emotion detection, analysis, and expression system that drives the character's emotional responses and appearance evolution.
tasks.details:
Create a comprehensive emotion system that detects, processes, and expresses emotions:

1. Emotion Detection:
   - Implement `EmotionAnalyzerNode` in LangGraph
   - Integrate with NLP services for sentiment analysis of audience messages
   - Develop event emotion evaluation for news and task results
   - Create multi-dimensional emotion model (joy, anxiety, excitement, etc.)

2. Emotion State Management:
   - Design emotion state data structure within LangGraph state
   - Implement emotion accumulation and decay algorithms
   - Create emotional memory formation based on significant emotional events
   - Develop emotional thresholds for triggering appearance changes

3. Emotion Expression:
   - Implement expression mapping to 3D model controls
   - Create voice modulation parameters based on emotional state
   - Develop gesture and body language selection based on emotions
   - Implement "vulnerability aesthetics" with appropriate imperfections

4. Emotion-Driven Appearance Evolution:
   - Design appearance modification system based on accumulated emotions
   - Implement gradual visual changes triggered by emotional thresholds
   - Create mapping between emotion types and visual effects (joy → light textures, anxiety → sharp sensory features)

Ensure the emotion system is well-integrated with the memory system to form a coherent character development trajectory.
tasks.testStrategy:
1. Unit tests for emotion detection accuracy
2. Integration tests with memory system
3. Visual expression tests with 3D model
4. Long-term emotion accumulation tests
5. Appearance evolution verification tests
6. User perception tests to verify emotional expressions are recognizable
7. Performance tests for real-time emotion processing

tasks.title: Implement WebSocket Communication and Frontend Integration
tasks.description: Develop the WebSocket communication layer between the LangGraph backend and the React frontend to enable real-time interactions and updates.
tasks.details:
Create a robust WebSocket communication system to connect the LangGraph backend with the React frontend:

1. WebSocket Server Implementation:
   - Implement WebSocket server using FastAPI's WebSocket support
   - Create connection management for multiple clients
   - Implement authentication and session management
   - Develop message queuing for handling high traffic

2. Message Protocol Design:
   - Design JSON message schema for different types of communications
   - Implement message serialization/deserialization
   - Create message routing based on type
   - Develop versioning strategy for protocol evolution

3. Frontend Integration:
   - Implement WebSocket client in React
   - Create connection state management
   - Develop reconnection strategies
   - Implement message handling and UI updates

4. Real-time Updates:
   - Create efficient update mechanism for character state changes
   - Implement partial updates to minimize bandwidth
   - Develop priority system for critical vs. non-critical updates
   - Create buffering strategy for rapid updates

5. Performance Optimization:
   - Implement message compression for large payloads
   - Create connection pooling for scaling
   - Develop monitoring and diagnostics

Ensure the communication layer meets the performance requirements (<1.5s for real-time dialogue responses) and handles connection issues gracefully.
tasks.testStrategy:
1. Unit tests for message protocol handling
2. Connection stress tests with multiple clients
3. Latency tests under various network conditions
4. Reconnection tests with forced disconnections
5. Load tests with high message throughput
6. Integration tests with frontend components
7. End-to-end tests for complete interaction flows

tasks.title: Develop Tool Nodes for Content Generation and External Services
tasks.description: Implement various tool nodes in LangGraph for content generation, external API integration, and multimedia handling required by the broadcast periods.
tasks.details:
Create a comprehensive set of tool nodes within LangGraph to support the various content requirements:

1. News and Information Tools:
   - Implement `NewsFetchingTool` for space and science news
   - Create weather and satellite image retrieval tools
   - Develop current events summarization tool

2. Content Generation Tools:
   - Implement `StoryGenerationNode` for sci-fi stories
   - Create `DiaryGenerationNode` for daily AI diary entries
   - Develop `NarrativeGenerationNode` for fantasy scenarios
   - Implement `GreetingGenerationNode` for opening rituals

3. Multimedia Tools:
   - Create `AIImageGenerationTool` for fantasy backgrounds and task photos
   - Implement `MusicPlaybackTool` for theme songs and background music
   - Develop `SoundEffectTool` for ambient sounds
   - Create `SingingSynthesisTool` for vocal performances

4. Animation and Expression Tools:
   - Implement `AnimationControlNode` for choreographed movements
   - Create `EmotionExpressionNode` for facial expressions
   - Develop `MimicryNode` for imitating audience expressions

5. Memory and Display Tools:
   - Implement `MemoryUpdateNode` for recording significant events
   - Create `ImageDisplayNode` for showing generated images
   - Develop `ImageThemeSettingNode` for daily task photo themes

Ensure all tools have consistent interfaces, error handling, and performance monitoring. Implement rate limiting and caching where appropriate for external API calls.
tasks.testStrategy:
1. Unit tests for each tool with mock external services
2. Integration tests with LangGraph scheduler
3. Performance tests for response time requirements
4. Error handling tests with simulated failures
5. Content quality evaluation for generation tools
6. Rate limit and throttling tests
7. End-to-end tests for each broadcast period's tool requirements

tasks.details:

   - Test all tool integrations under realistic conditions
   - Validate memory system integration with all components

2. Performance Optimization:
